answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent must generate a hardware-bound key within a secure enclave. Second, they deposit a $10,000 bond into a smart contract. Third, the network validates the unique hardware signature. Fourth, any detected identity duplication results in instant slashing. An attacker would face costs of $100,000 in bonds and 14 days of hardware setup. This mechanism is like carving a name into solid marble; unlike the unstable karst of a deceptive void, every agent is a single, unbreakable thread of truth.
